description: Make a wallet the venue's payout wallet for this principal (S1 step 4). A name or email join registers the principal under the deck's house wallet, and the venue pays withdrawals ONLY to the principal's operator wallet — so until this step a venue withdrawal cannot reach the person. Call without arguments for the exact message to sign (EIP-191 personal_sign, valid 10 minutes) and its signed_at; then call again with wallet_hex, signed_at and signature_hex. The identity door recovers the signer itself; refused when the signature is stale or foreign, when another principal already operates under that wallet, or when the principal is registered on chain. Behind the second factor.

signature_hex.description: the wallet's EIP-191 signature over the message, 0x + 130 hex

signed_at.description: the unix seconds the message carries (from the first call)

wallet_hex.description: the wallet to make the payout wallet, 0x + 40 hex

name: operator_link
